comment: Index of delivered render3d rigs. Written by tools/billboard_intake.mjs --backend 3d and the render3d workbench's exported payloads — not by hand. Same schema as billboards/assets/manifest.json (model, heightM, approved, inheritClips, clips.<state>.from), plus: toon — per-character overrides of the TOON defaults in render3d/src/toon.js ({ shadeTint: [r,g,b], shadeThreshold, shadeSoftness, biasScale, rimColor, rimStrength, rimPower }); a material's own glTF extras win over this block. Resolution order per state: clips[state].from, then the rig's own clip, then inheritClips, then the default pose set.
